theCodebase.heading: The Codebase
paragraphs: Built on {{total_hours}} hours of dedication ({{years_dev}} years full-time equivalent), this project represents what happens when a veteran developer refuses to accept 'good enough.' Every line of code - all {{loc_count}} of them - exists to solve a problem that other VA tools ignore.

Behind the interface lies {{validation_count}} validated disabilities, each one cross-referenced against the official 38 CFR regulations. I didn't scrape this data from random websites. I spent {{validation_hours}} hours reading the actual federal regulations, line by line, because veterans deserve accuracy, not guesswork.

The {{research_hours}} hours invested in understanding Title 38 regulations means you're not getting amateur interpretations. You're getting the same criteria VA raters use, translated into tools that actually help instead of confuse.

This isn't a weekend project that got lucky. It's {{total_hours}} hours of architecture decisions, edge case handling, and obsessive testing. The market value? Easily {{market_value}}. The price to you? Free. Because veterans shouldn't have to choose between paying rent and understanding their benefits.

whyFree.heading: Why It's Free
whyFree.content: Other organizations charge ${{competitor_price}}+ per use or take 30% of your backpay. I charge nothing because I've seen too many veterans get exploited by people who view their suffering as a revenue stream. This tool cost {{total_hours}} hours to build - I chose to invest that time so you don't have to invest your benefits.

theRealCost.heading: The Real Cost
theRealCost.content: Traditional development would cost {{market_value}} at industry rates. AI-assisted development let me build it in {{actual_hours}} hours ({{productivity_multiplier}}x multiplier), but the value remains the same. That's the gift I'm giving to the veteran community: enterprise-grade tools with zero strings attached.

longForm.body:
This project represents {{total_hours}} hours of work ({{years_dev}} years full-time equivalent) that I'm giving away for free. While AI helped me build it in {{actual_hours}} hours, the value remains {{market_value}} worth of veteran-focused tools.

I've spent {{validation_hours}} hours validating {{validation_count}} disabilities and {{research_hours}} hours reading federal regulations. Zero revenue. Zero ads. Zero data collection.

If this tool saves you from paying ${{competitor_price}}+ to predatory services or helps you secure the rating you deserve, consider buying me a coffee. It's not required—just appreciated.
